browser.notes: Final exact standalone and built game in Chromium. All four natural cave regions render, and a real portal leads to a naturally accumulating mixed Cinderworld threat that attacks in Survival. New cases use actual crafting/clicks/keys, boat launch/riding/steering/seated F5/save-reload/quick dismount, obsidian/flint portal travel, all three structure family renders, a real flier spawn egg, natural telegraphed fireball and actual click reflection that damages the shooter. Two real contexts verify host-authoritative Survival guest boats without reconnect-token exposure. Retained cases cover wood-to-pickaxe, real HTTPS/WSS, all held-item near-plane/crosshair and skin fixes, local MP3 discs, Creative Stands and snow/tornado behavior. Offline cases abort external requests; all assert no JavaScript/WebGL errors. Screenshots inspected.

limits: New world required for generator 14 connected terrain and irregular caves; wider structure spacing retained; old recorded generators remain intact.
One-seat approximate water-only boats; 32 per dimension; no animal/passenger transport or boat-to-boat collision.
Survival guest movement is host-authoritative with client prediction; Creative guests observe host boats. Existing dimension travel restrictions remain.
Weather is one saved host-influenced world clock, not independent regional cells.
Three seeded structure architecture families, not reference jigsaw generation.
Local flier collision steering can be blocked by complex buildings; four/six natural fliers and shared nearby hostile caps 18/26/32 by difficulty, 48 projectiles.
Fireballs damage targets but do not alter terrain/start spreading fires.
Native Windows launch remains unverified; no hardware FPS or zero-bug guarantee.
